editorial.blurb: Rickshaw serves up vibrant Pakistani and Indian street food with care for quality basics and a genuine commitment to community.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the biryani with naan ($13+) for an excellent value meal—reviewers rave about the portion size and spice level; it's a neighborhood standout away from the Devon Avenue parking headaches.
